title: A large-spectator accumulated barrier for a specified fixed-word class
statement: For a fixed finite native shape using all three handles on positive measure, zero signed areas and frozen first/second coefficients vanishing over the gain box and global variants, arbitrary correlated global sign choices admit a coin-independent deterministic bath/input with full trace error>=1-exp(-gamma*N*d^4) at sufficiently small word-dependentd. A12^N-dimensional spectator and retired labels are allowed; native prefix/suffix with bath zero there cannot recover the lost complement of span{I,X2}. For the46segmentexample gamma=1288225/164268 and conservative d0 about3.59e-7. The local quartic-noise witness from another return is weaker and cannot simply be summed into this result. Neither covers changing word shapes, richer internal waveform randomization or every native policy.
